Studying at a UK university For degree-level study on a Student visa you need English at CEFR B2. You can prove it with a SELT, but a university that is a Higher Education Provider may also assess your English itself. This is why universities can accept tests that are not SELTs, such as TOEFL iBT, the Duolingo English Test or Cambridge C1 Advanced. For study below degree level, the requirement is B1 and a SELT is normally needed. Always check your university's list.
